lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ ge rén?
lines.en: How many people are in your family?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 我家有四个人。爸爸、妈妈、姐姐和我。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu sì ge rén. Bàba, māma, jiějie hé wǒ.
lines.en: There are four of us: my dad, my mum, my older sister and me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you have an older brother?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 没有，我有一个姐姐。她在外面上班。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu, wǒ yǒu yí ge jiějie. Tā zài wàimiàn shàngbān.
lines.en: No. I have an older sister. She works outside the home.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 真不错！我弟弟也想做医生。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn bùcuò! Wǒ dìdi yě xiǎng zuò yīshēng.
lines.en: That's great! My younger brother wants to be a doctor too.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Nà hěn hǎo. Nǐ māma ne?

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 她是老师，她让我好好学习。
lines.pinyin: Tā shì lǎoshī, tā ràng wǒ hǎohǎo xuéxí.
lines.en: She's a teacher, and she tells me to study hard.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's the same in every family.
